profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Agile Defense
profile.summary:
Positive, results-driven, and innovative IT professional with proven ability to architect large Business Intelligence Analytic systems, develop web-based IT applications for both enterprise and C2S cloud environment, deliver infrastructure and security compliant solution.  Extensive design and optimization experiences in large scale government database focusing on the implementation of advanced technology and secure solutions.  Positive team player in all of the collaborative works while achieving the quality results.
I am interest in cleared position by US company deployed and working in Korea or 100% remote where I can work in Korea.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
o	Senior Software Engineer and Technical Architect to design, develop, maintain tools and services for cyber security tools to enable TSA cyber security analysts to analyze and visualize near-real-time status of its resources.
o	Participate in Backend development in Java Spring Framework using Spring Boot and the related extensions with Postgres database to run in Docker containers as various microservices.
o	Participate in Front End UI development using Angular framework via VS Code
o	All customer requests and requirement are captured and updated in team Jira.
positions.insights: Skills: Java · Docker Products · Data Architecture · Python (Programming Language) · Transact-SQL (T-SQL)

positions.title: Senior Data Engineer, Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
o	Senior Data Engineer and Data Analyst supporting Mission activities and Business tasks.
o	Designed, Developed and Improve automation tools that connect to various data sources and 
ETL (Extract, Transform and Load) to SQL Db for further Transformation.  Tasks included using Python scripts, PowerShell scripts and VB scripts to ETL the various data such as spreadsheet workbooks, .csv flat files, SharePoint lists.  
o	Managed and administered MS SQL Server instance and its database including handling credentials.
o	Developed SQL Stored Procedure scripts for various data connections and data transformations.
o	As one of the SharePoint Site Collection Admin, performed site management and admin tasks.
o	As a SharePoint Site Collection Admin facilitated the customer data access by developing data gleaning scripts for SharePoint sites and contents.  Additionally, enabled data connections between MS SQL Database and SharePoint sites, allowing data aggregation. 
o	Participated in creating Dashboard presentations for the clients using Tableau BI tools, which required various data to be available through the aforementioned ETL processes and SQL dbs.  
o	Engaged in presenting, negotiating and collaborating with various data owners and stakeholders to gain accesses to the data for Tableau dashboards.  
o	Established GitLab Ultimate project site for our development group.

positions.title: Sr. Software Engineer (Full Stack), System Architect
positions.description:
o	Active Clearance TS/SCI w/ CI Poly
o	Senior as Software Engineer and Technical Architect to design, develop, maintain tools and services for mission critical large data enabling DoD users to analyze and visualize near-real-time status of its resources.
o	Involved in procuring, designing and maintaining AWS C2S Cloud resources in establishing and maintaining clusters of various servers functioning different tasks hosted in Windows and Linux platforms for both Prod and Test environment.
o	Involved in assessing, procuring, standing up and maintaining various cloud servers in 
o	Iaas environment : Windows Servers (SQL, Web, Azure DevOp, utility), Linux E2C
o	Paas environment: MS SQL, MS IIS
o	S3 Storage buckets in secured environment for data transfer, backup
o	System administered Windows, MS SQL, Visual Studio and custom data analytic server clusters.
o	Develop, update and maintain a data analytic server tools using .NET VB, Javascripts hosted by IIS web servers. 
o	Develop, update and maintain T-SQL codes required for the data analytic tools.
o	Maintain and modify middleware VB codes that load data unto SQL database and backup.
o	Administer Azure DevOps Server (Team Foundation Server) for .NET code management.
o	System administered Linux E2C load-balancing cluster servers.
o	Update and maintain Linux server security certs, bash scripts and cron jobs that launches various scripts connecting to sftp server, pulling data and processing to produce .csv middle ware data and log throughout the processes.
o	Develop, update and maintain ETL (Extract Transform Load) data using Python, Java script codes that connect to SFTP servers and pull them for further processing.  Type of ETL data included XML, Json, binary, csv, txt resulting in producing .csv file in a common shared data storage for the middle ware system to upload to SQL database.
positions.insights: Skills: JavaScript · Python (Programming Language) · Java · SQL · Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) · Visual Basic .NET (VB.NET)

positions.title: Sr. Software Engineer (Full Stack)
positions.locationName: 12015 Lee Jackson Hwy  Suite 400 Fairfax, VA  22033
positions.description:
•  Active Clearance TS/SCI w/ CI Poly 
•  Served as Senior Software Engineer in the designing, developing various Web Apps and Tools relating Cyber Defense System.
•  Current application development using HTML, CSS, Php, Javascript, Bootstrap, Jquery, Python with MySQL, SQL, Elastic , Json in AWS C2S environment
•  Research and testing code develop in .Net, SQL, Store Procedures and other non Java language AWS C2S Laboratory environment
•  Utilizes Agile development in AWS C2S Agile Development and DevOp environment with gitHub, Jira.

positions.title: Senior IT Consultant
positions.description:
•  Active Clearance TS/SCI w/ CI Poly 
•  Served as Senior Technical Architect and System Administrator a web portal in the design, development and maintenance of the system.
•  Tibco Spotfire System Administrator providing graphical and analytic Business Intelligence services to all DIA workforce interfacing with various of Agency data.
•  Involve in DIA Tableu BI Tool working group in system architecting and migration planning from Spotfire System to Tableu System for DIA Enterprise and as well Intelligence Community at the GovCloud C2S environment.
•  Stood up Spotfire BI System onto GovCloud C2S environment for various customers in the Intelligence Community. 
•  Provided Cybersecurity Analytics for the DNI affiliate cyber defense team using data parsing tools and Spotfire BI tool with data generated from different data sources.

positions.title: Senior IT Security Specialist
positions.description:
•   Architect and manage enterprise Tableau Business Intelligence System for government organization.
•   Architect and manage enterprise Spotfire Business Intelligence System government organization.
Design and develop web portal business operation group of government organization.
•   Architect and Manage Enterprise Knowledge Base infrastructure project using KGS Data Confidence Methodology
•   Design and configure F5 load balanced cluster DIA Enterprise Spotfire servers suites of servers utilizing DIA MS SQL 2008 database farm
•   Administer Spotfire servers in connecting to various DIA Enterprise databases via Spotfire connection scripts to MS SQL, Oracle, Teradata, Sybase, Big Data, Excel and other JDBC, ODBC databases  
•   Built TIBCO Spotfire system in IC GovCloud environment Cross Domain Network traffic configuration
•   Built and configured Production Web Portal using – MS SQL 2008 Database, MySQL v5.x Database with Php v5.x and phpMyAdmin, Apache http v2.x, Tomcat v7, JSP, javascript, ExtJS, AJAX.  Tibco SpotFire v5.0.x Server installation and configuration.  FTP server installation and configuration
•   Developed ExtJS front-end Web Application User Interfaces with server side php scripts from ExtJS UI connection to MySQL database
•   Developed php scripting of Google mapping interface
•   Develop jsp application to interface with DoDIIS PKI Certifying Authority (DIAS) to configure PKI Certificate routine for different IT COP user groups 
•   Provided Enterprise data ETL(Extract Transformed Load) support by performing MS SQL DBA tasks and developed wrappers between the data discovery engines(php, Endeca, Spotfire) and the structured and unstructured client data sources using API documenting in Interface Control Document(ICD).
•   Develop Data Asset Repository in MS Access for project data analysts to gather and track data source to be used as application development requirement.

positions.title: IT Consultant
positions.description:
•	Upgraded and maintain Oracle 10g from previous versions of database for Consular Affair of State Department American Citizens Service system.  
•	Maintain Oracle Replication Servers between 232 world wide posts and the Washington DC, State Department Oracle database.  
•	Written server side PL/SQL script to fix the bugs arise from application maintenance releases.  
•	Develop schedule jobs to run Perl/Oracle using Windows Scheduler and batch files that calls Perl scripts.
